entries.german: Mannlehenurkunde des Eberhard, Abt des Klosters Michelsberg zu Bamberg, über zwei Höfe zu Retzstadt, eine Wiese zu Thüngen sowie Gültzahlungen zu Stetten und zu Volkach an Burkhard Schenk von Rossberg.
entries.english: Eberhard, abbot of Michelsberg Abbey in Bamberg, issues a male fief charter to Burkhard Schenk von Rossberg for two farms at Retzstadt, a meadow at Thüngen, and rent payments at Stetten and Volkach.

facts.content: received from Abbot Eberhard of Michelsberg Abbey a male fief comprising two farms at Retzstadt, a meadow at Thüngen, and rent payments at Stetten and Volkach.
